title: Sonatype Nexus Repository 3 returns the private signing key of a YUM proxy or group repository to an account that…
description: Sonatype Nexus Repository 3 has a vulnerability where an account with only read privileges on a YUM proxy or group repository can obtain the private signing key of that repository. This key allows the holder to sign repository metadata, potentially compromising repository integrity. The vulnerability does not require edit privileges, only read access.
